name: Asahi Group Holdings
h1: Rebuild and expand on one connected layer
lede: As Asahi restores its Japanese systems and prepares to integrate East African Breweries, Airtable gives teams one standard way to run cross-functional work.
why_h2: Recovery and expansion in the same year
why_p: Asahi is restoring operations after the September 2025 cyberattack while taking on a major acquisition, both of which call for clear, shared coordination.

signals.title: Systems restoration after the cyberattack
signals.body: FY2025 results were delayed after the 29 September 2025 cyberattack, and the company aims to fully restore its Japanese systems in 2026.
signals.angle: A rebuild is a natural moment to standardise how teams plan and track cross-functional work.

signals.title: Asahi Breweries resumes full shipments
signals.body: Asahi Breweries was reported to be fully resuming shipments following the cyberattack.
signals.angle: Coordinate supply, sales and customer recovery plans in one shared view.

signals.title: Agreement to acquire Diageo's EABL stake
signals.body: Asahi agreed to acquire Diageo's 65 percent stake in East African Breweries, with completion expected in the second half of 2026 subject to approvals.
signals.angle: Run integration workstreams, approvals and brand plans across regions from one system.
